tei:div.tei:head: A Prayer for the Reader
tei:div.tei:p: O God, faithful King, Almighty, Supreme King, accept my devoted and confident prayer. O Lord our God, the Lone God, the living God, the truthful judge, the righteous ruler, merciful and gracious, have mercy upon me and hear my prayer today when I pray for myself and my family and all my congregation who join in my prayers. Include my prayer among the upright and pure prayers that Israel offers, and let it come beneath Thy glorious throne just as Thou didst to the prayer of MosesMenasseh, so that those who sent me may not be put to shame through me, nor I through them. May the words of my mouth find favour and the meditation of my heart before Thee, O Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer, Amen, Selah. May it be Thy will, O Awe-inspiring One, to give me a pleasant and sweet voice today so that my voice may not fail me and my throat not burn; let my voice be pleasant and strong, as it is written: ‘ And the sound of the Shofar increased in strength ’. Amen, Selah.
